name: Vernal-Codex
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past geothermal vent fields, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Toxic air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
